author: Mental Outlaw
description:
In this video I explain the Linux root RCE exploit CVE-2026-98432 and how Ubuntu has been delayed in releasing bug fixes as well as communicating when the bug fixes are actually available.  Community supported distros like Debian, Alpine, and Arch Linux have been able to release fixes for their users while most Ubuntu LTS distros remain unpatched.
